overview_description.description:
SpecCheck, backed by Y Combinator (W23), is an all-in-one solution that provides accurate prescription eyewear ordering and tracking, seamless billing, and streamlined communication between patients, eye doctors, and their lab partners. SpecCheck’s users work more efficiently and make fewer costly errors, increasing productivity and improving their overall workflow.

Get in touch today for a product demo and to learn more!

about_short_description.short_description: SpecCheck is a cloud-based software that provides unified technology solutions for the optical industry.

product.name: SpecCheck Dashboard
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing prescription lens orders, tracking order statuses, and facilitating communication between optical practices and labs.

product.name: Lab Pay
product.description: A secure, cloud-based billing and payment portal for optical labs to automate invoicing, manage payments, and reconcile financial records.

product.name: Order Entry Tool
product.description: An online tool for eye care professionals to submit prescription lens orders with built-in validations and real-time catalog updates to reduce errors.

product.name: Live Chat Support
product.description: A real-time communication feature enabling eye care professionals to connect instantly with optical lab customer service for order inquiries and support.

product.name: Integrations with Optical Industry Software
product.description: APIs and software integrations connecting SpecCheck with practice management, lab management, accounting, and frame data systems to synchronize data and streamline workflows.
